articles.title: OpenAI Dots: Sam Altman’s unveiled ChatGPT AI personal agent, how does it work and what can it do for users?
articles.description: OpenAI has launched Dots, an innovative personal AI agent designed to perform tasks autonomously with minimal user input. Equipped to manage projects, schedule meetings, and oversee budgets, Dots operate seamlessly in the background using the advanced GPT-6 Astra model for accurate task execution. Furthermore, users can establish custom safety measures, ensuring specific actions require necessary approvals. This initiative reflects OpenAI's commitment to advancing AI technologies for businesses and consumers alike.
